title: One Chance Marketplace
tagline: One Chance Marketplace delivers a scam-free, bot-free platform, ensuring secure and private transactions through Worldcoin.
description:
Nearly 50% of internet users have fallen victim to scams, due to the relentless creativity of online fraudsters. However, this will no longer be a concern with One Chance Marketplace.

One Chance Marketplace provides an entirely scam-free and bot-free platform, guaranteeing secure and confidential transactions through the innovative technology of Worldcoin. The Worldcoin mechanism ensures that duplicating accounts is impossible on our platform, eventually leading to a complete elimination of scammers in the long run.

Experience a worry-free digital marketplace like never before. 
So why wait? Join us at One Chance Marketplace today and transact with confidence!
how_its_made:
One Chance Marketplace is a cutting-edge platform emphasizing the utilization of Worldcoin technology and its proof of uniqueness. Registration with Worldcoin is required to ensure a bot-free and scammer-free environment.

This platform is driven by the desire to maintain all transactions in a decentralized manner. Therefore, after registration, users need to connect their crypto wallets. We aim to offer flexibility by allowing people to get paid on any blockchain of their choice. For example, a user can receive USDC on Ethereum, Gnosis, Polygon, or ZKsync.

Our roadmap is quite clear:
- Prioritize anonymity with the integration of ZKbob, which ensures private transactions.
- Implement XMTP for decentralized chat, allowing encrypted end-to-end communication between buyers and sellers using their crypto wallet addresses.
- Launch 🚀

In essence, One Chance Marketplace is not just a marketplace but a revolution in the world of online trade, creating a safe, secure, and flexible environment for both buyers and sellers. It is a unique blend of technology, security, and decentralization.
